title: Curated list, sites on the LOLA polar products: past landings and one representative Artemis III point, 24 months
description: Site records of the data stream (data/sites/curated_sites.json): past landing sites at the lander positions measured on LROC images, and one representative point of an Artemis III candidate region. Real terrain from every approved elevation product, without the 5 m near field; SPICE ephemeris. The requirements are the team's examples, not requirements of NASA or of any mission. The terrain height error is the sourced default model of the contract, which the data stream measured on the polar products that serve these sites.

dem_height_error_model.label: Two sigma for the LOLA products: on the 5 m site rasters twice the producers' RMS error map at the pixel (1 m where the map is empty); on every other product 5 m up to 30 degrees of slope and 7 m above
dem_height_error_model.source: Data stream, 14 November 2026: data/checkpoints/near_field_report.json (20 m product minus 5 m site rasters, 0.64 to 1.1 million points per site, by slope class) and data/checkpoints/height_error_report.json; RMS maps *_toterr of the 5 m site rasters of Barker et al. (2021), read through lsn_data sample_quality. The RMS maps are the producers' model estimate, not a test against independent data. Every product is built from LOLA returns: errors common to all LOLA products are not covered.
